steps.en: Register the repo as a Claude Code plugin marketplace
steps.zh: 把仓库注册成 Claude Code 的插件 marketplace

steps.en: Install all 17 skills as one plugin
Claude discovers the skills and activates the one matching your current task on its own
steps.zh: Claude 自动发现技能，并在你当前任务命中时自行激活对应那个

steps.en: Startup loads only names and descriptions; a skill's full body, scripts and references load on activation
steps.zh: 启动只载入名字和描述，被激活时才加载完整正文、脚本和参考

steps.en: Or copy a single skill into one project when you don't want the whole pack
steps.zh: 不想整包时装单个技能也行

value.en: a named vocabulary — degradation, compression, multi-agent handoffs, evaluation — for diagnosing why a long agent run goes bad, instead of improvising per run
value.zh: 诊断长跑 agent 出问题的成套词汇——退化、压缩、多 agent 交接、评估——不必每次现场发挥
